LanguageData.PhobosFireTank_FillDesc: Send the nearest free colonist to run the portable pump and fill {VEHICLE}'s fire-fighting tank from open water within {CELLS} cells: a river, a lake or a marsh. It takes a while; the tank fills as they work.
LanguageData.PhobosFireTank_RefuseEmpty: {VEHICLE}'s fire-fighting tank is empty: land beside open water and pump it full.
LanguageData.PhobosFireTank_RefuseNotLanded: {VEHICLE} must be on the ground to fill its tank.
LanguageData.PhobosFireTank_RefuseNoWater: No open water within {CELLS} cells of {VEHICLE} for the pump's hose.
LanguageData.PhobosFireTank_PassDesc: Choose a point. {VEHICLE} flies a straight line through it from where it is and empties its fire-fighting tank onto a strip along the line, centred on the point, putting out the fires beneath. Then it flies on and holds.
LanguageData.PhobosFireTank_MsgPassStarted: {VEHICLE} is making a water drop pass with {LITRES} L, wetting about {CELLS} cells along its line.
LanguageData.PhobosFireTank_MsgPassCalledOff: {VEHICLE} has called off its water drop pass; the water stays aboard.
LanguageData.PhobosFireTank_MsgPassDone: {VEHICLE} has dropped {LITRES} L of water and put out {FIRES} fires.
